investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 triage refinement: a single unauthenticated GET to the venue's official website (or official programme URL when directly given), no retries, no browser, no authentication, no challenge bypass, no state-changing request.

probe_history.reason: The retained homepage listing proves The Cockpit is a mixed theatre/music fringe venue rather than resolving cleanly to either side of the music gate; a bounded per-event pass is needed before a READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF or REJECT decision would be honest.

identity.notes: The retained response's own <title> is "The Cockpit" and its meta description states "The Cockpit is a theatre in Marylebone, London", matching the candidate name and Gateforth Street, NW8 8EH address.

venue_location.notes: The retained response's own address text corroborates the candidate's discovery-supplied address, but this probe did not promote it to a canonical venue fact.

reasons: The venue's own retained meta description self-identifies as "a theatre in Marylebone... shows, events and knees-ups of every stripe", and its retained listing headings are dominated by plays, spoken word and Shakespeare (e.g. "Krapp's Last Tape", "Extremism by Anders Lustgarten", "Family Shakespeare: Pyramus & Thisbe").

The same retained listing also includes genuinely musical bookings — "Sam Glaser Quintet, Charlotte Keeffe + Sylvie Noble" (a jazz line-up), the operas "Orpheus and Euridice" and "The Dunwich Horror: An Opera", the song-cycle "Frauenliebe und Leben", and "Peter and the Wolf" — so this is a genuinely mixed fringe venue that needs deeper per-event filtering rather than a single accept/reject call.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, contiguous excerpt of the actual HTTP response body from the single unauthenticated GET, plus real response metadata (status, final URL, content-type); the excerpt substring is a literal transcription of the response but is wrapped in a JSON envelope with metadata rather than the full raw byte stream, so it is not itself the byte-faithful response.
evidence.method: curl -sL; descriptive research User-Agent; 20-second timeout; redirects followed; unauthenticated GET; no retry.
